verdict.rationale: A real community ecosystem exists: open-weight replicas such as Open-Jev-9B, Open-Jev-2B and openjev are on Hugging Face, and a 1,253-star awesome-jev list catalogs 339 projects. The evidence labels the replicas as third-party and not TypeSafe products, and the list states that a listing is not an endorsement. Because TypeSafe's own weights are unpublished, these are LoRA reproductions of the idea on Qwen, not fine-tunes or quantizations of the official model, and the official-versus-unofficial distinction is not documented by TypeSafe itself. missing for 10: true fine-tunes/quantizations of official Jev weights, a first-party TypeSafe statement attributing which derivatives are official, independent hands-on validation of the replicas.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a real derivative ecosystem exists around the model — community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations on public hubs — with clear attribution of what is and is not official
